changes.title: Samsung’s newest foldable finally feels Ultra
changes.summary: While we wait for Apple's rumored foldable iPhone , Samsung is polishing a design it already has on the market. I just spent three hours with my hands on the new Z Fold 8 Ultra, and all I can think about is how Samsung finally made the crease invisible.
